envelope.description: Replacement table: auth, origin, adapter assignee and pull request rows

body.title: Replacement table: auth, origin, adapter assignee and pull request rows
body.summary: Add the ghAuthOk form returning the {ok, reason} result, gitOriginOwnerRepo over git_remote and parseGithubRemoteUrl, the adapter's direct rows (readAssignees, setAssignee and addAssignee with the re-read checks, openPullRequestOf, the pull request create with the PULL_URL_RE parse, readSignoffState and readSignoffRequest over gh_pr_view jsonFields), the openSignoffRequest inner catch that rethrows ToolDenied and logs other failures, and the attach.ts tracked check over git_ls_files, git_status and git_log.
acceptanceChecks: assignee read, set and add keep their validations, re-read checks and error messages
a denied signoff link comment fails the stage and a retry reuses the open pull request
an untracked file (empty git_ls_files list) is refused with the old reason
ghAuthOk form returns {ok:true} and {ok:false, reason} as tracker-auto reads them

tests.name: registry-table.test.ts: ghAuthOk form, gitOriginOwnerRepo form and the attach tracked-check rows
adapter-registry.test.ts: assignee read, set and add with the re-read checks, signoff pull request list, create and view rows, a denied link comment and a retry that reuses the open pull request
